general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 50h online + 3h offline + 1h Final exam + 96h self-study
general_information.Description: This course facilitates students' comprehension of the impact of transmedia storytelling on engaging and influencing audiences. Students will gain expertise in creating, distributing, and participating in cohesive stories across various traditional and digital channels—for purposes including entertainment, marketing, and social activism. Ultimately, learners will proficiently create and communicate their own transmedia narratives across diverse media channels.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course(s) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in the courses., regularly study the course at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded) 4. Communicate and discuss in forum 5. Attend offline sessions in the Campus (Optional) 6. Must complete the course(s) with certification(s) in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
general_information.Note: 1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 2) Theoretical Exam (TE) 3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE + Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand and acquire the capability to develop transmedia storytelling strategies for diverse, engaging narratives.
Demonstrate proficiency in effectively engaging with and understanding diverse audiences in storytelling contexts.
Demonstrate the capacity to create cohesive user experiences across multiple digital platforms
Possess the ability to ultilise emerging technologies for effective story dissemination.
